purpose: Diagnose and correct the two reproducible GTSAM parity failures without weakening tests or changing the sealed v3 candidate.

baseline.result: 2/2 passed; parity max=0.00221519 m, RMS=0.00221207 m

current_before_fix.result: both tests failed; parity max=14.76482132280678 m, RMS=14.764821320646401 m, DD pseudorange RMS=8.7279074314755238 m, DD carrier RMS=8.6730679514964528 m, ambiguity cycles=100.4..104.4
current_before_fix.controlled_difference: The only backend source additions relative to HEAD were ordinary Pose3 TDCP support and clock-motion support; the failing DD-only test does not use TDCP.

root_cause.condition: The newly added GTSAM clock-motion block created a clock-state chain whenever motion/clock-motion defaults were enabled, even when need_clock_states was false because the DD-only problem had no undifferenced pseudorange/carrier factors.
root_cause.failure_mechanism: This injected an unanchored clock gauge into the DD-only factor graph and changed the LM solution, producing the observed position/residual/ambiguity failures.
root_cause.evidence: A single condition change requiring need_clock_states restored the clean-HEAD parity result; no test threshold or test fixture was changed.

fix.change: Require need_clock_states && use_motion_factors && use_clock_motion_factors before adding clock BetweenFactor<double> rows.

post_fix.result: 2/2 passed; parity max=0.00221519 m, RMS=0.00221207 m; ambiguity recovery passed

sealed_candidate_preservation.note: The backend fix is a separate current-tree correctness repair; the already sealed v3 executable bytes were not rebuilt or changed.
